我已获取所需材料，下面分点作答。

---

## 1. Intelligent Cloud 收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（三个月截至 2026/6/30） | FY25 Q4（三个月截至 2025/6/30） |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306M | $29,878M |

- 同比增长额 = $39,306M − $29,878M = $9,428M
- 同比增长率 = $9,428M ÷ $29,878M ≈ **31.6%，披露为 32%**（按固定汇率口径为 31%）

**出处：** `financial_statements.txt` 第 18,895 字符附近的分部收入表（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025）；`press_release.txt` 第 3,115 字符："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"。

---

## 2. 管理层在电话会上的归因（原话）

以下为 `transcript.txt` 第 25,060–25,270 字符区间内，负责 Intelligent Cloud 分部的管理层（Amy Hood）所述原话：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by **efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet** as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**. **That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.** Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value**."

补充背景：同一段中还提及"on-premises server business... Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"，但这是 on-premises server（属于 Intelligent Cloud 内的子业务），增速基本持平/同比 −1%，不是增长主因。

---

## 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity | **已发生事实** | 用现在时 "continues"，描述的是本季度已观察到的供需状态，且是 Azure 43% 增速的已实现背景 |
| 2 | Efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet | **已发生事实** | 用过去时态 "was ahead of expectations driven by…efficiency gains"，是对本季度已实现业绩的归因 |
| 3 | Process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity | **已发生事实** | 同样为 "was…driven by" 结构，描述本季度已经实现的效率改进，且管理层在前文提到本季度"added another gigawatt of capacity" |
| 4 | That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized | **已发生事实** | 明确时间状语 "in-quarter"（本季度内），"was quickly monetized" 是已完成的变现行为 |
| 5 | Stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value | **已发生事实** | "the June business model change" 指已经发生的定价模式调整，"stronger-than-expected…consumption" 是对本季度已实现结果的描述 |
| 6 | "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply"（展望部分） | **前瞻性表述** | 出现在 outlook 段落，用 "remain focused on"、"bridge the gaps we see"，指向未来 H1 增长加速的目标，而非已实现的结果 |
| 7 | "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" | **前瞻性表述** | 明确使用 "we continue to expect"，是对 FY27 上半年的预测 |

**区分方法说明：**
- **时态与语气**：已发生事实使用过去时（"was driven by…"、"was quickly monetized"）或描述当前已完成状态的现在时（"continues to exceed"——指 Q4 报告中呈现的现状）；前瞻性表述使用 "expect / remain focused on / we see" 等展望性措辞。
- **上下文位置**：已发生事实集中出现在 Amy Hood 对 Q4 业绩回顾（"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment…"）的部分；前瞻性表述集中出现在之后的 outlook 段落（"Now to the outlook…"、"For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion…"）。
- **合同/合同时间锚点**：已发生事实均有明确的时间锚点（如 "in-quarter"、"following the June business model change"、"against a prior year"），前瞻性表述则指向未来期间（"H1"、"FY27"、"first quarter"）。

综上，管理层对 Intelligent Cloud Q4 32% 增长的五条主要归因**全部属于已发生事实**（Azure 需求与产能瓶颈、CPU/GPU 效率、产能交付流程改进、本季度产能快速变现、GitHub Copilot 6 月商业模式调整后消费超预期）；电话会后段展望中提及的"继续聚焦效率 bridging the gap""H1 加速"等才是前瞻性表述。
